title.narrative: Facilitating evidence-based mainstreaming of Education for Sustainable Development in teaching and learning in Uzbekistan

description.narrative: This initiative aims to integrate sustainable development principles into the country's education system. This element involves mapping existing ESD activities, developing a national roadmap, and organizing stakeholder consultations. Key activities include conducting a comprehensive analysis of ongoing ESD efforts across all education sectors, from preschool to higher education. The outcome of this activity will be a draft national roadmap for the ESD 2030 Country Initiative, incorporating findings from the mapping study and stakeholder inputs. Implementation will be done through deep scrutiny of the teaching and learning materials, consultation, and validation meetings for the roadmap development, followed by awareness and capacity building.
